parsed.note_claim: Prince Harry is not a working royal and official guidance states he and Meghan are private citizens whose charitable work is undertaken in a private capacity.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The charitable work of the Duke and Duchess is a personal matter for them both and undertaken in their private capacity. In short, their position is akin to private citizens with commercial and charitable interests.
parsed.reason: The page publishes the text of the official letter from the Lord Chamberlain on behalf of King Charles confirming the couple are not working royals and their work is private.
